parties.petitioner: Piramal Capital and Housing Finance Limited

summary: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code; resolution plan approval; avoidance applications under s.66; CoC's commercial wisdom; priority of creditors; fixed deposit claims; supremacy of IBC over RBI Act and NHB Act; NCLAT's interference with approved resolution plan; procedural compliance under s.30(2) IBC; reconsideration of resolution plan remanded; multiple appeals consolidated.
legal_provisions_cited: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 s.45-IE(4)(a)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; NCLAT's direction to reconsider resolution plan set aside; approval of resolution plan upheld; supremacy of IBC over sectoral laws affirmed; commercial wisdom of CoC upheld; fixed deposit claims not entitled to full repayment; impugned judgments modified.
